message.reasoning_content: We need to identify crimes based on facts: illegal hunting of two second-level protected animals (original chickens) using self-made chain and hooks, killing and storing for consumption. Chinese criminal law: illegal hunting, killing, and possessing protected wildlife. Relevant statutes: Criminal Law Article 338 (illegal hunting, killing, trading protected wildlife). Also possibly violation of wildlife protection law, but criminal law article 338 covers illegal hunting, killing, etc. Also maybe "非法狩猎罪" (illegal hunting). Also "非法捕猎、杀害国家重点保护野生动物罪". The value is 1670 RMB, but that may affect severity (maybe "情节较轻" but still crime). So only one crime: illegal hunting of protected wildlife. Could also be "非法捕猎罪" (illegal hunting). The fact includes using self-made chain and hooks, storing in freezer. No evidence of trade, just personal consumption. So crime is "非法捕猎、杀害国家重点保护野生动物罪". In Chinese criminal law, article 338: "非法捕猎、杀害国家重点保护的野生动物或者非法收购、运输、出售、利用国家重点保护的野生动物的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金或者没收财产。" So the crime is "非法捕猎、杀害国家重点保护野生动物罪". So answer: [罪名]非法捕猎、杀害国家重点保护野生动物罪<eoa>
